tooltip.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.transmi: Upgrades up to 8 lower-tier transmitters in the same network to this tier, nearest first. Consumes one installer on success.
ageofexpansionmodpackfix.configuration.t: Age of Expansion Modpack Fix Configs
ageofexpansionmodpackfix.configuration.s: Age of Expansion Modpack Fix Configs
Age of Expansion Modpack Fix Configs
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.stat: Stopped: no input power or input overload
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.inpu: Enter an integer from 0 to 16,777,216 SU.
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.port: Align shaft faces with the ports: teal input, gold output.
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.sett: Right-click to configure; close to save. Speed: right clockwise, left counterclockwise.
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.side: Left/right when facing the front. Wrench to rotate.
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.stat: Redstone stop: no input stress consumed
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.reds: A redstone signal stops generation and releases input stress.
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.rati: Drag to set output ratio. Arrow keys or wheel for fine adjustment.
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.spee: Drag horizontally: right clockwise, left counterclockwise, 1–256 RPM. Arrow keys or scroll to fine-tune.
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.comb: Combines two stress inputs into an independent output.
gui.ageofexpansionmodpackfix.router.spli: Distributes input stress between two independent outputs.
